state_definitions.explicit_disabled_override: bOverride flag=false is explicitly serialized; a serialized value, including false or zero, is retained without treating it as an enabled override.
state_definitions.override_without_serialized_value: bOverride flag=true is serialized, but no paired value is serialized; the inherited/native value is unknown.
state_definitions.value_and_explicit_override: A value and bOverride flag=true are serialized in this branch; effective volume blending and runtime overrides remain unverified.
state_definitions.value_without_explicit_override: A value is serialized, but no matching bOverride flag is serialized; the omitted flag is unknown rather than assumed enabled.

value_pairing_policy: Literal names are paired first; a unique bool bX value may pair with bOverride_X only when no X value is serialized. All original Settings keys are retained.
